extraction.notes: The main official page announces tentative 2027 weeks, June 13–18 and June 20–25, and says registration is expected by mid-December 2026. These are not confirmed program-specific dates or an exact opening date, so cards retain 2026 dates and registration milestones are empty. Direct page opens returned no readable content; evidence below is exact text exposed by search indexing of official pages. Registration uses Camp Doc, but its destination URL was not exposed. Current official headings still show 2026 waitlist notices for Engineering, Meteorology and Zoology despite those sessions being in the past. The official summer-camps overview also names App Development & Foundations of Coding, but no program page or dated details were found. Creative Writing has two different curricula, represented separately; Engineering's identical weeks are combined.
